title: Appendix G — Extrinsic Index
raw:
## Appendix G — Extrinsic Index

The consensus-critical extrinsics an implementer builds against (normative signatures; errors/events
abbreviated). The full on-chain operation map is On-Chain Flows.

### G.1 Compute channel — `pallet_compute_channel` (sole inference-dispatch path, §12.1)

| Extrinsic | Origin | Effect | Key errors |
|-----------|--------|--------|-----------|
| `open_channel(miner, model_hash, measured_root, decode_policy_hash, precision, enclave_key, agent_key, sla, escrow, nonce, settlement_class)` | agent (signed) | reserve escrow; fix Appendix F.3 `SettlementClass`; snapshot the miner-calibration assurance tier; verify measured root vs. registry; state → `Open` | root mismatch; reservation-cap exceeded; expired lease |
| `force_open(miner, model_hash, measured_root, decode_policy_hash, precision, agent_key, sla, escrow, nonce)` | agent (signed) | fix `SettlementClass::Standard`; state → `PendingAck { ack_deadline }`; no session signing key bound | reservation-cap exceeded |
| `force_ack(channel_id, enclave_key)` | named miner (signed) | bind the provenance-neutral session signing key; snapshot the miner-calibration assurance tier; state → `Open` | not the named miner; window elapsed |
| `register_session_evidence(channel_id, slot, commitment, size_bytes:u32)` | named miner (signed) | funded Open channel only; allocate bounded Ephemeral DA via R5.3g; identical retry preserves expiry; emit SessionEvidenceRegistered only for a new slot | NotAParty; BadState; ZeroToplocCommitment; VerifiedTurnOutOfBounds; SessionEvidenceTooLarge; SessionEvidenceConflict; registry errors |
| `expire_force_open(channel_id)` | anyone (signed) | refund escrow in full; `FailedAcks += 1` if escrow ≥ floor | still within ack window |
| `top_up_escrow(channel_id, amount)` | agent (signed) | raise reserved-capacity cap (splice-in) | channel not `Open` |
| `settle(channel_id, final_root, aggregate_gn, claimed_measured_root, agent_receipt_sig, transcript_ref, verified_turns)` | miner (signed); agent bilaterally signs receipt | verify versioned receipt, every explicitly versioned turn signature/path, distinct indices, checked aggregate, calibration/`GnSink`, measured root, required TOPLOC record, and no open escalation; immediate private reserved-escrow payout; no public work credit (R11.2b/E.44) | `BadReceiptSignature`; `UnsupportedLeafVersion`; `AggregateGnMismatch`; `TooManySettlementTurns`; `MerklePathTooLong`; `GnTripwireRejected`; root/TOPLOC/escalation errors |
| `force_settle(channel_id, final_root, aggregate_gn, claimed_measured_root, agent_receipt_sig, transcript_ref, verified_turns)` | miner or agent (signed) | verify the same receipt/turn/claim gates; compute two-part tariff `P`; open challenge window | receipt/turn/root/claim errors; rejects `P > E` with `TariffExceedsEscrow` (R12.1d) |
| `finalize(channel_id)` | anyone (signed) | after the challenge window, pay `P` → miner, `(1−φ)(E−P)` → agent, `φ(E−P)` → `FLOPFoundationAccount` (zero burn, R12.1d); `P` is in the escrow's base unit (10⁻¹⁸ FLOP), with `channel_base_per_turn = rate_G = 1` base unit | window not elapsed; open dispute |
| `timeout(channel_id)` | anyone (signed) | non-delivery → full refund (`φ=0`) | not past `max_duration` |
| `open_dispute(channel_id, contested_turn)` | session agent or active validator | lock [`channel_challenger_bond`](#param-channel_challenger_bond); contest one settled turn, which the miner answers with `respond_dispute` | `NoDisputeStanding`; `DisputeTurnNotSettled`; `DisputeExists`; window elapsed; transcript unavailable |
| `open_bisection_dispute(channel_id, n_turns)` | session agent or active validator | lock the challenger bond; `n_turns` equals the settled power-of-two leaf count (2 to `MaxSettlementTurns`); begin midpoint rounds over the whole bundle | `BisectionBadTurnCount`; `DisputeTurnNotSettled`; standing and window errors as `open_dispute` |
| `respond_bisection(channel_id, left_root, right_root)` | named miner (signed) | open the two child roots, whose hash equals the interval's parent root; reset the response window | `NotAParty`; `BisectionNotAwaitingResponse`; `BisectionBadChildRoots`; window elapsed |
| `challenge_bisection(channel_id, choose_left)` | the dispute's challenger | pick the left or right half; once one turn remains, the miner answers with `respond_dispute` | `NotAParty`; `BisectionNotAwaitingChallenge`; `BisectionRoundCap`; window elapsed |
| `respond_dispute(channel_id, leaf_version, turn_index, h_in, h_out, g_n, decode_policy_hash, h_ids, toploc_commitment_hash, miner_recv_ms, miner_done_ms, latency_ms, enclave_sig, merkle_path)` | miner (signed) | select exactly one Appendix F leaf preimage; verify signature + Merkle membership | unsupported version; bad signature/path; window elapsed → fraud default |
| `report_toploc_mismatch(channel_id, evidence)` | active validator | quorum-judged activation mismatch → forgery slash | uncalibrated cell (fail-closed inert) |

### G.2 PoUI direct rail — `pallet_flop_poui` (synthetic/ghost/calibration/simulator, §3.6)

| Extrinsic | Origin | Effect |
|-----------|--------|--------|
| `submit_stark_batch(proofs, gn_weight, task_hash, latency_ms, model_hash, output_hash)` | miner (signed) | record in `PendingVerifications`; replay-guard `ProcessedTasks[task_hash]` |
| `submit_validator_attestations(bundle)` | none (unsigned inherent; `ensure_none`) — validator identity authenticated by the signatures inside the bundle, not the extrinsic origin | verify sigs + active-validator check + tuple agreement + quorum; on quorum verify `report_data`/`output_hash`, credit `gn_weight`, fire `OnProofVerified` |
| `set_validator_attestation_threshold(perbill)` | root/governance | set the BFT quorum fraction |

### G.3 Staking, calibration, vesting, DA, HTLC

| Extrinsic | Pallet | Effect |
|-----------|--------|--------|
| `register_miner(commission)` / unbond *(commission, `delegate`, and `set_commission` deprecated, D-0530)* | `miner_staking` | self-stake bond ≥ capacity-proportional requirement (§6.1); slash-locked unbond |
| `register` / `rotate` / `un_jail` / `rejoin` / `do_slash` | `validators` | `register` freezes `effective_minimum_stake()` and queues in `ValidatorQueue`; `rotate` promotes from `ValidatorQueue` to `ActiveValidators` and ejects/thaws; `un_jail` (after `MinJailBlocks` = 3,600 for liveness jail) and `rejoin` (for extended-downtime kicks, topping up self-stake to `effective_minimum_stake()`) restore directly to `ActiveValidators` while below `ActiveSetCap` = 1,000; single slash authority |
| `sponsor_register_miner(miner, amount, commission, reward_policy)` / `sponsor_top_up(position_id, amount)` | `miner_staking`; sponsor (signed) | R6.1a; rejected unless [`sponsored_self_stake_enabled`](#param-sponsored_self_stake_enabled) (`SponsoredSelfStakeDisabled`). Register: `register_miner`'s admission checks, `amount ≥ required_self_stake_for(miner)`, sponsor backing beyond its existing staking freezes and index room; records own stake 0 plus an Active sponsor position frozen at the sponsor; emits `MinerRegistered{self_stake: 0}` then `SponsorPositionCreated`. Top-up grows the caller's Active position (`SponsorPositionToppedUp`). Release: `sponsor_unbond` → `sponsor_withdraw`; `deregister_miner` unbonds every Active position unless the miner is busy. The slash-proceeds account is rejected as sponsor here and, on enabled runtimes, in `sponsor_miner`. On enabled runtimes the sponsor may hold no other staking freeze in either staking pallet, here and in `sponsor_miner`, and a sponsor account cannot then `register_miner`, `top_up_self_stake` or `delegate` (`SponsorStakeOverlap`). `register_miner` and this call wait until the account's positions from an earlier registration are withdrawn (`StaleSponsorPositions`); the operator may withdraw them after the finalized unlock and fully unbond an orphaned one. A quarantine from the activation scan (`LegacyOverlapCount`) suspends all sponsored credit. Errors `InsufficientSelfStake`, `InvalidSponsorAmount`, `TooManySponsorPositions`, `NotSponsor`, `InvalidSponsorPositionStatus`, `SponsorIsSlashProceedsAccount`, `SponsorStakeOverlap` |
| `sponsor_register_validator(validator, amount, reward_policy)` / `sponsor_top_up(position_id, amount)` | `validators`; sponsor (signed) | R6.1a; same gate. Register: `register`'s admission checks, `amount ≥ effective_minimum_stake()`, no active sponsorship left from an earlier registration (`StaleSponsorPositions`); queued like `register`; emits `ValidatorRegistered{self_stake: 0}` then `SponsorPositionCreated`. Top-up as for miners. `deregister` unbonds every Active position. The slash-proceeds account is rejected as sponsor here and, on enabled runtimes, in `sponsor_validator`. The same one-staking-freeze rule applies, with `register`, `rejoin` and `delegate` as the own-stake paths (`SponsorStakeOverlap`). On enabled runtimes `sponsor_unbond` moves an active validator it takes below the effective minimum back to the queue (`MinimumActiveValidators` at the floor) |
| `accept_benchmark_burst(...)` / `renew_benchmark_cap(...)` | `hw_calibration` | stake-backed aggregate cap / lease renewal |
| `claim_vested()` | `airdrop_vesting`; beneficiary (signed) | use the finalized head; require an existing grant and positive unlocked amount above `claimed`; reduce the grant freeze and emit `AirdropClaimed`; errors `NoGrant`, `NothingToClaim` |
| `record_attested_gpu_inventory(...)` / `record_hardware_fingerprint(...)` | `hw_calibration` | identity binding; change invalidates |
| `batch_issue_calibration_jobs(...)` | `synthetic_tasks` | issuer-selected timed one-shot pack |
| `create_grant(miner, amount)` | `work_vesting` | Root only; require the miner's non-zero finalized §7 calibration baseline and snapshot it as `B_p` (R8.1) |
| `force_create_grant(miner, amount, pledge_baseline)` | `work_vesting` | Root only; explicitly bypass the finalized calibration-baseline check with a non-zero caller-supplied `B_p` (R8.1) |
| `register_miner(model_hash, gpu_model, vram_gb, tee_type)` / `set_measured_root` | `model_registry` | model availability + measured dm-verity root |
| DA register / audit / `top_up_lease` / `withdraw_lease(commitment)` | `da_registry` | `DataRef` commitment; serve-or-slash audit; free lease top-up; `withdraw_lease`: publisher (signed); requires an existing `Leased` blob, matching publisher, and `pin_count == 0`, with no `lease_end` condition; removes the blob (no further audits can be issued) and refunds the full deposit to the publisher; does not cancel an audit issued before withdrawal (E.47); errors `UnknownBlob`, `NotLeased`, `NotPublisher`, `BlobPinned`; emits `LeaseWithdrawn`, `LeaseDepositRefunded` |
| `create/redeem/refund_htlc`, `create_cross_chain_htlc`, `relay_preimage`, `register_relayer` | `has-station` | HTLC lifecycle (§10); permissioned relayer |
| session-key / agent-wallet delegation, caps, revoke | `session_keys` / `agent_wallet` | §6.2 delegated autonomy |

---

### G.4 Paid object storage (§5.4)

**R5.4p — Interface pinning.** These are logical interfaces; E.54 **MUST** pin bounded wire types and dispatch indices before
activation. Every call **MUST** reject an inactive/unknown profile. Events **MUST** include affected
reservation/lane/object identifiers and accounting deltas without private contents or keys.

| Signature | Origin | Preconditions / principal errors | Event |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vote_tariff(epoch, tariff)` | eligible validator | next epoch not yet started; counted only with a capacity declaration; duplicate / ineligible | `TariffVoteRecorded` |
| `declare_capacity(epoch, encoded_bytes)` | eligible validator | collateral available under the E.54 bond profile; not reused across obligations; ineligible / insufficient collateral | `CapacityDeclared` |
| `open_reservation(reserved_bytes, term, max_cost, nonce)` | payer | valid capabilities, funds for `C_rent` at the current tariff within `max_cost`, free declared capacity; unauthorized / insufficient budget or capacity | `ReservationPending`; `ReservationActivated` by protocol assignment at the next finalized randomness, or `ReservationAborted` with escrow returned |
| `extend_reservation(reservation, additional_term, max_cost)` | authorized funded renewer | fresh consent at the funding epoch's tariff, providers' declared capacity; closed / insufficient budget | `ReservationExtended` |
| `transfer_reservation(reservation, new_payer, consent)` | owner with new payer's signed acceptance | active reservation, no pending transfer; unauthorized / claims pending | `ReservationTransferred`; terms, providers and liability unchanged |
| `set_memory_head(namespace, key, expected_version, new_object)` | owner or scoped writer | optional chain-pinned slow path; exact previous version (chain-pinned or quorum-receipted); stale head / unauthorized | `MemoryHeadPinned`; authoritative for that key over provider receipts |
| `post_checkpoint(epoch, root, counters_commitment)` | assigned validator | one per provider per epoch within grace; duplicate / late / conflicting | `CheckpointPosted`; late or missing after grace is a fault |
| *(protocol action, no extrinsic)* rent release per epoch | block execution | historical slot holder's audit and checkpoint state accepted for the interval; challenge window elapsed; uncredited term positions; per-slot/tranche `R_sk(b) − R_sk(a)` only; checked arithmetic | `RentReleased` to the interval's holder, including after replacement |
| `challenge_storage(reservation, generation, evidence)` | profile-authorized challenger; anyone for equivocation | objective evidence: failed audit, missing custody receipt after the activation window, missing checkpoint after grace, or conflicting receipts/checkpoints; applicable bond/standing; stale assignment / invalid evidence | `StorageChallenged`; profile-bound `RepairAssigned` / `StorageFault` / `EquivocationSlashed` |
| `finalize_reservation(reservation)` | any caller, for an expired or failed reservation | finalized cause-bound end; only after bounded claims and liabilities close; settle surviving historical rent entitlements; no live holds; checked per-slot refund `Σ_k B_sk − paid − held`; claims pending | `ReservationClosed`, fault remedy where applicable, failed/unserved/forfeited rent and surplus returned to payer, prune authorization |
| `set_object_policy(namespace, expected_epoch, policy_commitment)` | owner | monotonic finalized epoch and bounded policy; stale epoch / unauthorized | `ObjectPolicyUpdated` |
| `fund_service_lane(reservation, provider, budget, nonce)` | payer | assigned provider, fresh nonce, aggregate wallet cap and held funds; unauthorized / over budget | `ServiceLaneFunded` |
| `redeem_service(lane, voucher)` | lane's provider, directly or through an authorized proxy dispatching as the provider; fixed payee | signature/domain/range; strictly increasing sequence and nondecreasing counters; exact pinned-tariff amount above paid and within budget; Closing requires known finalized height ≤ deadline regardless of signing time; only the cumulative delta; replay / overclaim / expired claim / unknown clock | `ServicePaid` |
| `close_service_lane(lane)` / `finalize_service_lane(lane)` | payer to close; any caller to finalize | fixed boundary at close inclusion or earlier reservation end; pinned deadline = boundary + claim window; preserve slot and escrow; refund exactly remaining escrow only with known finalized height > deadline; unauthorized / claims pending / unknown clock | `ServiceLaneClosing` / `ServiceLaneClosed` |
